[EN] The mandrills are wreaking havoc on our camp, tearing down scaffolding, moving objects around, and otherwise making it impossible to perform proper archaeology here in {@Rgn:30001$$Balder's Refuge}.

Wipe out the {@LinkCreature:30#510#direpaw} and {@LinkCreature:30#520#dreadpaw mandrills}.

See Leiria for some post-slaughter compensation.
[ES] Los mandriles están estropeando nuestro campamento, tirando andamios, moviendo objetos y haciendo que sea imposible realizar un trabajo arqueológico adecuado aquí en {@Rgn:30001$$Balder's Refuge}.

Aniquila a los mandriles {@LinkCreature:30#510#direpaw} y {@LinkCreature:30#520#dreadpaw}.

Busca a Leiria para obtener una compensación por la masacre.

[EN] Yep. That's a lot of dead mandrills.

Now wash that blood off.
[ES] Sí. Es un montón de mandriles muertos.

Ahora límpiate esa sangre.

[EN] Kill those mandrills before they tear our camp apart!
[ES] ¡Mata a esos mandriles antes de que destruyan nuestro campamento!
